We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.</p> <p>Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Opportunity.</strong></p> <p>As a Venture Development Manager, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of Retail Insights. items.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist at Retail Insights
items.snippet: <p>Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people? Are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Talent Acquisition Specialist.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.</p> <p>Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>As our Talent Acquisition Specialist, you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building the greatest brand within Insurtech. By providing you with the ownership of our recruiting, we want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone ensuring you become an expert. You’ll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:</p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to get operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business</li> <li>A chance to work closely with the CEO on our recruiting strategy</li> <li>Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and we have a track record of promoting internally</li> <li>12-month internship with the possibility of a full-time role either in recruitment or other departments of the company.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Watch this <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sxjgL64czRY">video</a> with our founder to learn more about our thoughts on recruiting.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:</p> <ul> <li>Coordinate with the CEO all the weekly strategy sessions and lunch meetings with candidates.</li> <li>Identify and engage potential candidates for outreach.</li> <li>Take responsibility for the first stage of the recruitment process. (CV Screening)</li> <li>Take ownership of the Recruitment Software, Greenhouse:</li> <ul> <li>Renew and update job postings via the platform.</li> <li>Update the job description to attract more candidates</li> <li>Ensure synchronization between FirstMind and Greenhouse.</li> </ul> <li>You will report to the senior recruitment and to the CEO</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we expect from you</strong></p> <p>We do expect you to:</p> <ul> <li>Have acquired a bachelor’s or master’s degree with outstanding results</li> <li>Have a UK work permit</li> <li>Have a natural ability to make people feel comfortable around you</li> <li>Take ownership of everything you do, be proactive and follow through on commitments</li> <li>Desire to get to know other people and learn, develop, and push yourself. </li> <li>No experience is needed. If need be, we will teach you everything you need to know about recruiting.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Start date</strong></p> <p>Flexible</p> <p>The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

If so, now is the time to apply for our 4 months paid Internship Program in London.</p> <h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>Retail Insights is part of United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer you</strong></h3> <p>As part of our Internship Program in London, you will rocket launch your career in a high-paced environment with a continuously steep learning curve. In short, we offer the brightest talents:</p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds</li> <li>An amazing network and the possibility of reporting directly to C-level staff and Managing Directors</li> <li>Given the opportunity to collaborate on projects with industry leaders </li> <li>Mentorship and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the founder of our company, Mads Faurholt</li> <li>Potential for permanent employment after the internship</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your responsibilities</strong></h3> <p>You’ll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on the role you’ll take, could entail responsibilities such as:</p> <ul> <li>Supporting our recruitment function covering everything from candidate sourcing to speaking with potential candidates</li> <li>Being part of creating connections with key players from the industry, like CEOs, entrepreneurs, for example, co-founders of Airbnb, Starbucks etc. building and maintaining valuable relationships with them.</li> <li>Working on marketing and SoMe content creation by developing, implementing and managing social media and marketing strategy</li> <li>Data analysis; extracting the correct data for analysis, and ability to interpret and relay the data.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h3> <p>You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:</p> <ul> <li>Have or are in the process of finishing your bachelor's with outstanding results</li> <li>Have experience from part-time work and/or from extracurricular activities</li> <li>Are fluent in English, written and spoken.</li> <li>Have exceptional attention to detail</li> <li>Possess exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Starting day</strong></h3> <p>January 2024. items.title: Leadership Program (MBA Graduate)
items.snippet: <p><strong>Are you ready to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of an exciting start-up revolution as the main driver for its growth and success?</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p><a href="https://retailinsights.org/denmark/">Retail Insights</a> is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.</p> <p>Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Opportunity.</strong></p> <p>On the Leadership Program, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of Retail Insights. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, ensuring the successful execution of the conference and strategy of the brand. </p> <p>You’ll want this job if you possess strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, highly ambitious, forward-thinking and driven to inspire and lead a team. You are someone who is thrilled to work in a fast-paced environment and wants to scale the company rapidly.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Recruit, build and develop a high-performing team. </li> <li>Build an ecosystem and deliver outstanding products.</li> <li>Set clear expectations, establish goals, and provide ongoing detailed feedback and performance evaluations.</li> <li>Execute the strategy at a rapid pace.</li> <li>Develop the company’s brand as the go-to place for inspiration, knowledge and networking. </li> <li>Oversee planning, execution, and completion of conferences within the designated timelines and budget constraints.</li> <li>Assign tasks to team members in each department, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are achieved.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to expand business with existing clients and collaborate with business development teams for new client acquisition.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London (next to Sloane Square), constantly pushing you out of your comfort zone to ensure a never-ending growth curve for you and the business. We provide you with the following:</p> <ul> <li>The opportunity to lead, run and develop a fast-growing business, where your work and the results are highly tangible and make all the difference. </li> <li>Work with an incredible team with a track record of developing and growing businesses. </li> <li>Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas. </li> <li>Competitive salary</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Requirement</strong></p> <ul> <li>+4 years’ experience from an institution with high speed and work ethic e.g. management consulting, investment banking, top-tier corporate or start-up. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree with outstanding results, maybe followed by an MBA</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness and a passion for business. </li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Proven track record delivering results.</li> <li>UK, EU or US work permit</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

items.title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
items.snippet: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. Context & Motivation A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for: Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert Higher availability and durability of customer data This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps. More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad Your Mission As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 1. State of the Art Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline: Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models) Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance 3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale: Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes 4. Evaluation & Validation Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. items.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
items.snippet: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. </p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. </p> <p>We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The highest level within our organization is <strong>ADR III</strong>. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our <a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

items.snippet: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote Level: Senior to lead Location: Remote, CET overlap Contract: Full time, long term About us We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft. The project Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same. Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this. About the role We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer. You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them. The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team. You report to the Art Director. What you will do Environment art Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit. Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts. Build modular kits that can be reused across levels. Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction. Level design Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared. Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine. Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results. Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression. Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines. What we are looking for Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development. Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish. Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts. A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final. Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity. Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it. Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials. Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning. Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team. Comfortable working in English every day, in meetings (mostly on camera) and in writing. It does not need to be perfect. Nice to have 3D character or gameplay animation. 3D character modelling. Technical art or VFX. Experience with GitHub or Fork. Experience with player-built levels, or tools for game creators. Experience in a small team where you covered more than one role. What we offer A fully remote team with flexible working. Trust to manage your own time. We do not use timesheets. Ownership of the game’s spaces, from first layout to final. A small team where people help each other. Working setup Fully remote. Your working day needs to overlap with CET. Full time, on a long-term contract. It is business to business. We would like you to start as soon as you are available. What this role is not Not a lead game designer role. Our Creative Director sets the direction of the game. Not an art-only or design-only role. You will do both. How to apply Apply through the link; a few short questions are part of the application form. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.</p> <p>We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.</p> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></p> <p>At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your role</strong></p> <p>In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery</strong>: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. </li> <li><strong>Direction</strong>: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.</li> <li><strong>Talent</strong>: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.</li> <li><strong>Culture</strong>: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.</li> <li><strong>Craft</strong>: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.</li> <li><strong>AI-first engineering</strong>: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.</li> <li>Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.</li> <li>Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.</li> <li>Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!</li> <li>Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).</li> <li>Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!</li> <li>1,000 EUR personal development budget.</li> <li>Complete coverage for commuting.</li> <li>Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.</li> <li>Gym membership discount with Wellhub.</li> <li>Dutch/English classes budget.</li> <li>Variable pension scheme.</li> <li>Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).</li> <li>Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. </li> <li>Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen directie, inhoudelijke experts en uitvoerende partners, brengt focus in uiteenlopende belangen en durft richting te geven.
